---
title: Tools
---

This page is reached through the **Tools dropdown** in the navbar.
The dropdown menu lists two entries:

- *Overview* (this page)
- *[Converter](converter.qmd)*

Both menu items are configured in `_quarto.yml` under
`navbar.left[*].menu`. Each item's `href` is a project-relative
`.qmd` path; the Render step rewrites it to `.html`.
